title: Sprint 60 Wave A — High ROI easy fixes from 10-agent audit
description:
Implement the highest-ROI, lowest-effort fixes identified by the 10-agent codebase audit (2026-07-10):

1. MSA-ADAPT-001: Fix creativeProvider.js CommonJS in ESM project (rename to .cjs)
2. MSA-CORE-017: Fix TaskSequenceGoal infinite loop on terminal completion (add _isComplete flag)
3. MSA-INFRA-006: Delete all .bak and .bak.bak files from repository
4. MSA-WEB-004: Derive version from AssemblyInformationalVersionAttribute instead of hardcoded string
5. MSA-CORE-005: Fix ClearAndEnqueueAsync silent catch — add ILogger
6. MSA-LLM-001: Fix doc comment typo in IntentManager.cs
7. MSA-TEST-001: Delete stale .bak files in test directory

Also commit and push the pending Data/Memories/Core knowledge base updates and audit documents from previous agent sessions.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body:
## Wave Complete — Evidence

Commit `413b8c3` pushed to `dev/round-3`. All 6 fixes implemented and validated:

### Fixes Applied

| Finding | Fix | Files Changed | Validation |
|---------|-----|---------------|------------|
| MSA-ADAPT-001 | Renamed creativeProvider.js → creativeProvider.cjs + updated require() path in index.js | `creativeProvider.cjs` (renamed), `index.js` | Build passes |
| MSA-CORE-017 | Added `_isComplete` flag to TaskSequenceGoal, set by TryAdvance when returning false, checked in IsComplete to prevent infinite loop | `TaskSequenceGoal.cs` | All 815 tests pass |
| MSA-INFRA-006 | Deleted 33 .bak/.bak.bak files across all layers | N/A (cleanup) | Build passes, no stale files remain |
| MSA-WEB-004 | Replaced hardcoded `"v0.55.0"` with `FileVersionInfo.ProductVersion` from assembly; updated header comment to Sprint 60 | `Program.cs` | Build passes |
| MSA-CORE-005 | Added `Action<Exception>? onStopError` callback to `ClearAndEnqueueAsync`; wired in ABS damage-interrupt caller with `logger.LogWarning`; updated test to verify callback invocation | `ActionQueue.cs`, `CoreModelsTests.cs`, `AgentBackgroundService.cs` | All 815 tests pass |
| MSA-LLM-001 | Fixed truncated `.z///` in IntentManager doc comment | `IntentManager.cs` | Build passes |

### Validation Results
- **Build:** 0 errors, 0 warnings
- **Tests:** 815 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped
- **Task records:** 353 records validated (PASS)
- **Repository:** 33 .bak files removed
